order: Apply the findings from an independent holistic review to the resource-tracking substrate and its round-three status, and commit the resulting verdict record. Ledger the outstanding exercise debt explicitly rather than leaving it implicit, extend the round-three window to forty-eight hours, and update the tracking module and its test suite to match the corrected behavior. Update the plan's status file and the band records for the affected work orders to reflect the same findings, and record the review's own verdict verbatim in a dedicated roster file alongside a first-round review record. Keep the change to records and the substrate implicated by the findings only — do not touch unrelated roster files.
claims: The exercise debt was ledgered explicitly, the round-three window was extended to forty-eight hours, and the tracking module plus its test suite were updated to match (nine files touched, 316 insertions, 48 deletions). The independent review's verdict was recorded verbatim in a dedicated roster file, a first-round review record was added, and the plan's status file and the band records for the affected work orders were updated to reflect the same findings.
